{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module TokenAuth where

import Data.Word (Word32, Word64)
import Data.Int (Int32)
import Data.Bits (shiftL, shiftR, xor, (.&.))
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BSC
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (getPOSIXTime)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Token structure: 4 bytes user_id | 4 bytes timestamp | 4 bytes permissions | 4 bytes checksum
data TokenFields = TokenFields
  { tfUserId      :: !Word32
  , tfTimestamp   :: !Word32
  , tfPermissions :: !Word32
  , tfChecksum    :: !Word32
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

-- Permission bits
permRead, permWrite, permAdmin, permSuperAdmin :: Word32
permRead       = 0x01
permWrite      = 0x02
permAdmin      = 0x10
permSuperAdmin = 0x80

-- Global session store
{-# NOINLINE sessionStore #-}
sessionStore :: IORef (Map.Map Word32 TokenFields)
sessionStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

-- Token expiry window in seconds
tokenExpiryWindow :: Word32
tokenExpiryWindow = 3600

-- Compute checksum over first 12 bytes of token data
computeChecksum :: Word32 -> Word32 -> Word32 -> Word32
computeChecksum uid ts perms =
  let h0 = uid `xor` 0xDEADBEEF
      h1 = h0 `xor` (ts `shiftL` 3)
      h2 = h1 `xor` (perms `shiftR` 1)
      h3 = h2 `xor` (h2 `shiftR` 16)
  in h3 .&. 0xFFFFFFFF

-- Parse raw bytes into token fields
parseToken :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe TokenFields
parseToken bs
  | BS.length bs /= 16 = Nothing
  | otherwise = Just TokenFields
      { tfUserId      = bytesToWord32 (BS.take 4 bs)
      , tfTimestamp   = bytesToWord32 (BS.take 4 (BS.drop 4 bs))
      , tfPermissions = bytesToWord32 (BS.take 4 (BS.drop 8 bs))
      , tfChecksum    = bytesToWord32 (BS.take 4 (BS.drop 12 bs))
      }

bytesToWord32 :: BS.ByteString -> Word32
bytesToWord32 bs = foldr (\(i, b) acc -> acc + fromIntegral b `shiftL` (i * 8)) 0
                   (zip [0..3] (BS.unpack bs))

-- Validate token integrity
validateChecksum :: TokenFields -> Bool
validateChecksum tf =
  let expected = computeChecksum (tfUserId tf) (tfTimestamp tf) (tfPermissions tf)
  in tfChecksum tf == expected

-- Check if token has expired
-- Uses Int32 arithmetic for time difference calculation
isTokenExpired :: TokenFields -> Word32 -> Bool
isTokenExpired tf currentTime =
  let timeDiff = (fromIntegral currentTime :: Int32) - (fromIntegral (tfTimestamp tf) :: Int32)
  in timeDiff > (fromIntegral tokenExpiryWindow :: Int32)

-- Validate permission level required for operation
hasPermission :: TokenFields -> Word32 -> Bool
hasPermission tf requiredPerm = (tfPermissions tf .&. requiredPerm) /= 0

-- Rate limiting state
{-# NOINLINE rateLimitMap #-}
rateLimitMap :: IORef (Map.Map Word32 (Word32, Int))
rateLimitMap = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

-- Check rate limit: max 100 requests per minute
checkRateLimit :: Word32 -> Word32 -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit userId currentTime = do
  rlMap <- readIORef rateLimitMap
  case Map.lookup userId rlMap of
    Nothing -> do
      modifyIORef' rateLimitMap (Map.insert userId (currentTime, 1))
      return True
    Just (windowStart, count) ->
      if currentTime - windowStart > 60
        then do
          modifyIORef' rateLimitMap (Map.insert userId (currentTime, 1))
          return True
        else if count >= 100
          then return False
          else do
            modifyIORef' rateLimitMap (Map.insert userId (windowStart, count + 1))
            return True

-- Main authentication function
authenticateRequest :: BS.ByteString -> Word32 -> IO (Either String TokenFields)
authenticateRequest rawToken requiredPerm = do
  currentTime <- fmap (fromIntegral . (round :: Double -> Word32) . realToFrac) getPOSIXTime
  case parseToken rawToken of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid token format"
    Just tf -> do
      -- Step 1: Validate checksum
      if not (validateChecksum tf)
        then return $ Left "Invalid token checksum"
        else do
          -- Step 2: Check rate limit
          allowed <- checkRateLimit (tfUserId tf) currentTime
          if not allowed
            then return $ Left "Rate limit exceeded"
            else do
              -- Step 3: Check expiry
              if isTokenExpired tf currentTime
                then return $ Left "Token expired"
                else do
                  -- Step 4: Check permissions
                  if not (hasPermission tf requiredPerm)
                    then return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"
                    else do
                      -- Step 5: Register session
                      modifyIORef' sessionStore (Map.insert (tfUserId tf) tf)
                      return $ Right tf

-- Admin endpoint: requires superadmin
adminAction :: BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String String)
adminAction rawToken = do
  result <- authenticateRequest rawToken permSuperAdmin
  case result of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right tf -> return $ Right $ "Admin action performed by user " ++ show (tfUserId tf)
